summary: Everything the studio has made, not only the Souls games — 129 releases across three decades, taking in the mech series, the first-person dungeon crawlers, the ninja games, licensed mecha work, puzzle and sudoku titles, handheld and phone releases, one virtual reality game and one arcade machine. Versions of the same title are kept together, and each entry says which other releases are required and why.

entries.title: King's Field
entries.emulation: DuckStation's native widescreen enhancement — it expands the gte projection and applies per-primitive correction so sprites and hud are not stretched.
entries.remaster_caveats: (1) The 1994 PS1 original is Japan-only and is the game the Western renumbering hides. (2) King's Field Mobile (2004) is a retelling with different map layouts, quicksaving and an auto-map. (3) King's Field EX is enhanced again: expanded dungeons, new monsters, weapons and armour, new dungeon layouts and one-way doors. Each holds content the others do not ⇒ all three. Both keitai versions were preserved and English-translated in 2025, so they are genuinely playable.
entries.version_role: All three are required — they are different games, not versions of one.

Separately, the PS2 build has more maps and better AI and never came to North America. ⇒ both: International for the piloting and extra battles, PS2 for the maps and AI.

entries.title: Tenchu: Shadow Assassins
entries.emulation: Dolphin (Wii) or ppsspp (PSP) widescreen.
entries.remaster_caveats: Wii original (2008), a PSP conversion (2009), then 'Tenchu 4 Plus' (2010, Japan). Plus adds two-player co-op with new missions built around it, and — the part that matters — a character progression system letting Rikimaru and Ayame learn new abilities that apply to the original missions as well. So Plus changes the base game, not just the multiplayer. The PSP conversion also dropped the Wii's motion controls but gained section restarts on death. ⇒ content sits with Plus, fidelity with the Wii ⇒ both. Acquire developed this one; FromSoftware published it.
entries.version_role: Two playthroughs are required: no single release holds all the content, or the better looking one removed something.
